articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
articles.description: The Congressional Budget Office calculated the Defense Department's Iran war cost through Aug. 1 at $38.1 billion.

articles.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
articles.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

articles.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
articles.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

articles.title: Crypto Reacts: Bitcoin Slides as Clarity Act Fails to Clear Senate Vote
articles.description: The Senate fell short of the 60 votes needed to advance the crypto industry's marquee bill Tuesday. Bitcoin dropped as the no tally mounted, but the move stopped well short of panic.

articles.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic discussing collaboration on AI safety issues
articles.description: Discussions have been ongoing since Google's Demis Hassabis released a proposal in July calling for a U.S.-led "Standards Body," the spokesperson said.

articles.title: AWS says it can't restore service to Bahrain, UAE facilities 6 months after Iran strikes

articles.title: Clarity Act Stalls in Senate as Crypto Bill Fails to Clear Key Vote
